title: Hoodoo songs and the Marie Laveau song
summary: Love says many people still believe in hoodoo and that old songs were written about it, including a Marie Laveau song Papa Celestin used to sing.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Now what what about hoodoo in those days? Did people believe in it much? Oh yeah there's a lot of people believe in that up until now. Well is that right? Yeah but they used to believe in it and then they used to have songs about it. That's one of the old hoodoo songs.
They had many songs about it?
Oh yeah. They had Marie LaVoe. They had a song about her you know. Marie LaVoe.
Which song is that? Is that the one Sellefman?
That's the one Sellefman used to play. He used to sing it.
How long ago did he sing that?
Well he sang it all along. Oh. While he played you know.
Well he's been singing that song for years.
Oh for years yeah. Whenever you asked him like that he'd sing it.
